local cloneref = cloneref or function(...) return ... end
local CoreGui = cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
local function randomString()
	local length = math.random(10,20)
	local array = {}
	for i = 1, length do
		array[i] = string.char(math.random(32, 126))
	end
	return table.concat(array)
end
local HiddenGui = gethui or get_hidden_gui or function() return CoreGui end


local Crosshairs = {"rbxasset://textures/MouseLockedCursor.png", "rbxasset://textures/SpawnLocation.png"}
local Spin = true

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = randomString()
gui.Parent = HiddenGui()

local Crosshair = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
Crosshair.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
Crosshair.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.4, 44 + 3)
Crosshair.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
Crosshair.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
Crosshair.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Crosshair.Image = Crosshairs[2]
Crosshair.ImageTransparency = 0
Crosshair.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Crosshair.Parent = gui

while Spin do
Crosshair.Rotation += 2
task.wait()
end
